agent_notes: Every 'Likhmisar' record independently found (GeoNames, census mirrors, mapsofindia, jatland) points to the same real place: a pair of villages 'Likhmisar Utrada' (लिखमीसर उतरादा) and 'Likhmisar Dikhnada' (लिखमीसर दिखनादा), both in Sridungargarh tehsil of Bikaner district -- NOT Lunkaransar tehsil / Mahajan sub-tehsil where the 34-gaon firing range villages sit. No source placed a 'Likhmisar' inside Lunkaransar tehsil. Two detailed Rajasthan Patrika features specifically about the Mahajan Field Firing Range's 1984-85 acquisition of 34 villages (searched in full) name roughly a dozen displaced
